title: biomes.sizes/1
description: data/biomes/sizes.json: the planet sizes a match can pick (WorldPlanetSize; docs/world/planet-sizes.md). Version field: schema. Policy: every key required, objects closed except keys starting with an underscore. The loader also checks the rules JSON Schema cannot: cols a multiple of 64, arenaCols 600 to cols and a multiple of 8, bakeStride dividing cols / 16, and the default being medium's 4,800.

default.description: The size a setup that names none plays: medium.

cols.description: The planet's columns round (a column is 32 units).

arenaCols.description: The longest ring a fight is played on (on a field world: the planet's own round).

offered.description: A size a player can reach: in the menu's list, and what a setup's planetSize can name. A size that is not offered plays medium, with an error (held).

places.description: planet.json numbers this size changes: the place counts and the ring's minimums.
